findings.issue: 13 of 14 entries are status 'pending' with an activate_when regex; removing the rule the fixture proves turns the entry PENDING and run.py exits 0. Proven: check-blank:false -> go-blank-assigned-error PENDING exit 0; observability rule emptied -> PENDING exit 0; mobile .dependency-cruiser.cjs deleted -> every TS entry PENDING and check-architecture stays green (web config still found).
findings.fix: Mark every entry whose gate is in the tree 'active' and drop activate_when; make PENDING a failure under CI/GATE_FIXTURES_REQUIRE_ALL; fail check-architecture.sh when the mobile depcruise config is missing.

findings.issue: Relative-path laundering passes both TS gates: ui/shared/x.ts -> '../../shruti/stores/useChatStore' and ports/app/x.ts -> '../../infra/preferences/index' pass eslint (alias patterns only) and depcruise (no ui->shruti, ports->*, infra->ui|usecases|shruti, libs->app-layer rules). architecture.md claims depcruise enforces relative imports.
findings.fix: Add path-based depcruise rules for ports, infra upward, ui->shruti, @lib/ui->persistence/@ionic and libs/*->app layers, each with a relative-path fixture.

findings.issue: depguard is deny-by-prefix: application importing a new internal package that re-exports pgx (type Conn = pgx.Conn) passes; a //go:build prod file importing pgx is never linted; time.Until and math/rand in application pass forbidigo.
findings.fix: Per-layer list-mode strict allow lists (or deny internal/* except named layers), lint with the build tags production uses or forbid tags under internal/{domain,application}, forbid time.Until/After/Tick/Sleep and math/rand.

findings.issue: check-blank allowlist is whole-file: a new `_ = os.Remove("x")` in services/auth/internal/jwt/jwt.go passes errcheck. No exclusions.warn-unused, so the depguard/errcheck allowlists never fail when stale.
findings.fix: Scope each exclusion by the exact source call (or a //nolint:errcheck with explanation on the line) and set exclusions.warn-unused: true.

findings.issue: _package_graph reads _imported_modules, so `from shruti_chat import indexer` adds no edge and a package can join the cycle unnoticed (sanskrit->indexer proven); importlib.import_module/__import__ bypass every rule. Pinned by strict-xfail tests test_package_graph_sees_from_package_imports and test_runtime_imports_are_visible_to_directional_rules.
findings.fix: Build the graph from _imported_packages; flag importlib.import_module/__import__ string literals naming shruti_chat.*.
